# 1.2.54 - notices that wait for you

Nothing here asks a world to be migrated.

## Notices

- **A notice stays on screen until you close it.** Ordinary notices used to leave
  by themselves after twelve seconds, and a busy moment could push one off the
  screen before anybody had read it. A "waiting for the GM" card still closes
  itself once the GM has answered.
- **The newest notice is on top** and pushes the older ones down. When there are
  more than the notice tile can show, the older ones wait underneath instead of
  being thrown away. A small "+N" beside the close button says how many are
  waiting, and closing a notice brings the next one back.
- The Class Trial's evidence stage keeps its order, so an objection still reads
  after the presentation it answers.

## Fixed

- **The pressed Truth Bullet grouping button is readable again.** Under Stained
  Glass "Chapter" or "Location" turned into pale text on the pale highlight when
  selected, and under Monokuma Legacy the selected one did not look selected.

## Repository

- **New README and screenshots**, taken on a live world: the player's and the
  GM's screen at the same minute, a student sheet, Monokuma's sheet, the
  inventory and the GM panel.

276 regression tests pass on a live world.
